title: {item:essentialcraft5:void_crystal_pillar}
summary: The third tier of ESPE crystal pillar
items: essentialcraft5:void_crystal_pillar

blocks.text: Goal: make a {item:essentialcraft5:void_crystal_pillar}. The pentacle that summons demons needs 4, so this is the first step of the chapter.

Prepare: 6 {item:essentialcraft5:void_plating}s, 1 {item:essentialcraft5:void_core} and 1 {item:essentialcraft5:void_mru_reactor} around a {item:essentialcraft5:pale_crystal_pillar} (see [[pentacle/pale_crystal_pillar]]), which is used up.

It gathers ESPE just like the Mithriline Crystal Pillar ([[mithriline/crystal_pillar]]): {cfg:machines.mithriline_crystal_pillar.espe_generated} per tick under open sky ({cfg:machines.mithriline_crystal_pillar.espe_generated_end} in the End), up to {cfg:machines.mithriline_crystal_pillar.max_espe}; three blocks tall, and breaking any part removes the whole pillar. What differs is the tier: it is third of the five pillars (after mithriline and pale), and spots that ask for "void or better" accept only it and higher tiers.

items: The demonic pentacle: the 4 spots on the glowstone need it ([[demons/demonic_pentacle]]);
A tier 2 Soul Pentacle needs 4 ([[pentacle/tier_two]]);
An ingredient of the Demonic Crystal Pillar ([[pentacle/tier_three]]);
Its base gives <t>30</t> enchanting power, so two take a Magical Enchanter to level 60 ([[devices/magical_enchanter]]).

blocks.title: Save your cores
blocks.text: Void Cores and MRU Reactors only come from relic chests. Just reaching the demon summoning takes about 5 cores and 4 reactors for the pentacle and its 4 Void Crystal Pillars; do not spend them all on machines.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You get a Void Crystal Pillar.

title: Soul Scriber and Captured Souls
summary: Take souls of villagers, endermen, wind mages
items: essentialcraft5:soul_scriber
essentialcraft5:captured_soul

blocks.text: Goal (optional): take a {item:essentialcraft5:captured_soul} with a {item:essentialcraft5:soul_scriber}. Sometimes a demon wants not an item but the soul of a certain creature, and only this knife can take one.
Prepare: 1 netherrack, 1 nether quartz and 1 stick, in a vertical line.

items: Hit a villager, an enderman or a wind mage ([[wind_mage/wind_mages]]) yourself with the scriber.
If it has less than 1.5 hearts left after the hit, the scriber takes its soul: it drops dead with no loot, and a Captured Soul lies at its feet.
Killing it outright with the hit works too: it drops its loot as usual, plus one soul.
Souls are sorted by creature; souls of the same kind stack to 64, and the name in brackets says whose soul it is.
The scriber loses no durability hitting creatures; it hits for only 2 (a wooden sword does 4).
Only a player's own hit counts; machines and sweeping hits take nothing.

blocks.title: Taking a soul is a kill
blocks.text: The hit that takes the soul kills the creature: a villager frees its bed and workstation, and nearby golems and villagers remember it. It does not work inside someone else's claim.

title: Ackronite
items: essentialcraft5:ackronite_ingot
essentialcraft5:demonic_plate
essentialcraft5:demonic_core

blocks.text: Goal: turn the {item:essentialcraft5:ackronite_ingot}s a demon gives you into {item:essentialcraft5:demonic_plate}s. Ackronite only comes from demon trades, and nearly everything after it needs some.

Prepare: in a {item:essentialcraft5:magician_table}, 1 {item:essentialcraft5:magic_fortified_plating} in the middle and 4 Ackronite Ingots around it make 4 Demonic Plates for 2000 MRU (see [[crafting/magician_table]]). 4 Demonic Plates and 4 {item:essentialcraft5:elemental_gem}s around 1 {item:essentialcraft5:mru_resonating_crystal} make a {item:essentialcraft5:demonic_core}.

items: essentialcraft5:demonic_plate
essentialcraft5:demonic_core
A Demonic Core fitted to a Magician Table as an upgrade: speed <t>×16</t> ([[storage/upgrades]]).
Any recipe that takes a magic plate accepts a Demonic Plate, and any that takes a magic core accepts a Demonic Core; the weapon bench core slot takes a Demonic Core too.
4 Demonic Plates make 16 {item:essentialcraft5:demonic_plating} ([[demons/demonic_plating]]).
6 ingots, 2 Demonic Cores and a Void Crystal Pillar make a Demonic Crystal Pillar, needed for a tier 3 Soul Pentacle ([[pentacle/tier_three]]).
Ackronite Ingots as gun material: damage 26, 20 shots, no recoil; as a sniper scope, 16× zoom ([[guns/parts]]).

title: {item:essentialcraft5:demonic_plating}
summary: 16-color plating; works as a casing too
items: essentialcraft5:demonic_plating
It takes dye like the other platings: right-click with a dye to recolor it, sneak to dye an area ([[alloys/plating]]); it always drops white.
Hardness 3, blast resistance 60, needs a pickaxe.
It counts as an enrichment chamber casing block ([[enrichment/controller]]) and can form a Tesla coil base ([[tesla/mru_coil]]).
A tier 3 Soul Pentacle needs 4 ([[pentacle/tier_three]]).
The Magical Chisel carves it into 16 patterns ([[decorations/magical_chisel]]).
